import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { staff } from "../../../backend/schema/staff";

export const staffCms = customizeTable<typeof staff>("staff", {
    display: {
        title: "firstName"
    },
    sort: ["lastUpdate", "desc"],
    listFields: ["staffId", "firstName", "lastName", "username", "email", "active"],
    fields: {
        firstName: {
            multiline: true
        },
        lastName: {
            multiline: true
        },
        email: {
            multiline: true
        },
        username: {
            multiline: true
        },
        password: {
            multiline: true
        },
        lastUpdate: {
            readOnly: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: [
        "staffId",
        "firstName",
        "lastName",
        "username",
        "email",
        "active",
        "lastUpdate",
        "address",
        "store",
        "password",
        "picture"
    ]
});
